program.section_heading: Esthetician Concepts - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - AS1094/AS1094C/CE1094
outcomes: Deduce valid conclusions, compare viable techniques and apply principles in preparation of the California State Board of Barbering and Cosmetology practical and written exam.
Identify and analyze concepts leading to synthesis of theory for the state board written exam. Produce a business plan and portfolio.
Demonstrate entry level skills in a clinic laboratory setting.
Demonstrate workplace behaviors (soft skills) necessary for success in the cosmetology industry.

notes: The section heading covers both the A.S. Degree and the Certificate of Achievement (AS1094/AS1094C/CE1094); a single requirements list and a single Program Learning Outcomes list are printed for the program as a whole, and the A.S. Degree shares them.

The page also prints a separate heading 'Esthetician Concepts - Certificate of Achievement - CE961' with no distinct requirements beneath it; a reviewer may want to confirm which award the requirements belong to.
The second outcome is printed as one line containing two sentences ('...state board written exam. Produce a business plan and portfolio.'); it is recorded as one entry as printed.
No general education pattern is named in the text; the 20.00 total is the major requirement only.
